diagram_math_checks.justification: Definition lines 33–39 accepts dyadic full-dimensional sites. A=0, B=e1, C=e2, D=e3 and q=(1/4,1/4,1/4) are distinct dyadic sites with zero weights; q is the equal positive barycentric average, so lies strictly inside ABCD. All five four-point bases have nonzero affine determinant (absolute values 1 for ABCD and 1/4 for each q-facet tetrahedron).

Supplier def-three-dimensional-delaunay-and-weighted-regular-lower-hull defines height ||p||^2-w and lower support by all sites on/above z=ell(x). ABCD has ell=x1+x2+x3. At q the residual is 3/16-3/4=-9/16, hence the Definition cavity set difference deletes ABCD.

qABC has ell=x1+x2-5x3/4; omitted D has residual 9/4. Coordinate permutations give residual 9/4 for the omitted site of qABD and qACD. qBCD has ell=13(x1+x2+x3)/4-9/4; omitted A has residual 9/4. All included vertices have zero residual. Independently computed exact dyadic residual arrays in vertex order A,B,C,D,q: [0,0,0,0,-9/16], [0,0,0,9/4,0], [0,0,9/4,0,0], [0,9/4,0,0,0], [9/4,0,0,0,0]. These exhaust all five four-subsets.

The fixed-universe perturbation in def-lexicographic-lift-tie-break adds positive powers of formal epsilon. Nonzero rational constant residuals retain their sign in its ordered field. Thus this strict unweighted example illustrates the actual formal algorithm without introducing numerical epsilon or asserting an original-hidden/formal-hidden equivalence.

The affine drawing sends A to (0,0), B to (3.6,0), C to (1.3,2.6), D to (2.5,0.9). Their average is the drawn Q=(1.85,0.875). Explicit AB,BC,CA and AD,BD,CD yield all six boundary edges; QA,QB,QC,QD are the four new edges. Native tight figure shows all ten segments, closed ABC boundary and five distinct vertices. Crossings are explicitly nonvertices. No orientations or morphisms are asserted.

Original Definition bytes are preserved and the justifying theorem is untouched. The Remark supplies algebraic support checks, states the projection illustrates only this example, distinguishes weighted four-dimensional lift tests and asserts no general cavity connectivity.
